page.content:
Arthur's sister, enchantress, enemy and Avalon healer.

How Morgan le Fay connects

  • Location: Avalon — Morgan is among the queens of Avalon.
  • Character: King Arthur — Morgan plots against Arthur even as she later bears him to Avalon.

What is Morgan le Fay?

Morgan le Fay shifts from healer-sister to sorceress rival and back. She plots against Arthur and Guinevere, yet she is among the queens who bear him to Avalon.

Key threads lead to Avalon and King Arthur.
